scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text: Focus on the briefing.

## Received Message ##
## Team Alpha's last communication was at Oscar Sierra 52 177 ##
## Enter Message Input ##
## Enter Message Input ##
## No Communication Status ##
## Send Message Input ##
There is no trace of alpha. Only the radio.
Nothing in particular.
## Coordinates Received ##
^0000FFI think he stopped breathing.^000000
Krrr. I guess you're not someone of Regenschirm. Can you move aside, I have something to say to that person.
^0000FFThe mutant who's life is running out is trying to say something.^000000

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text: {0}, I didn't think I'd survive and see you again. You're pretty good.
Ask about the fallen mutant.

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text: Well, even if you ask me... it's the first time that I'll talk to a mutant.
... Est?

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text: How do you know my name? Who are you! I'll finish you painlessly, so be honest.
Est... Rebellion Ghost Squad... Do you remember uncle Miguel?

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text: How do you know that name...
Ha... haha... you still remember.
^0000FFThe identification tag on the mutant's neck stands out.^000000
Get the identification tag and hand it to Est.

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text: Mi... guel...?

scripts.speaker: Miguel
scripts.text: ... Est, the last thing I'll see... is your face... That's a relief.

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text: Uncle Miguel!? How did this happen!

scripts.speaker: Miguel
scripts.text: Before I die... I always wanted to see my old colleagues... You fulfilled my wish.

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text: Uncle! What is this! What happened to you?

scripts.speaker: Miguel
scripts.text: Ugh... I don't have much time left... Listen carefully, Est.

scripts.speaker: Miguel
scripts.text: Somewhere in here... the mad research results of Regenschirm... can be found somewhere in here.

scripts.speaker: Miguel
scripts.text: Find everything... and you'll know what happened to me... you'll see things that can't be explained here.

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text: Uncle! Wake up!! Let's go out. If we go out, we can save you!

scripts.speaker: Miguel
scripts.text: Est... you still have a big heart... that kind of feeling... on the battlefield... I taught you...

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text: Uncle! Uncle!!
Ask about Miguel

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text: {0}, I'm sorry but I don't feel like talking about him right now.
Ask about the records.

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text: I checked the northeast section and saw a place over the railway that seemed to be a research facility.

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text: Maybe the research Miguel was talking about... is somewhere in there. I'm going to have to start another operation right away.

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text: I don't think there will be anything else to do here.
I want to go back.

scripts.speaker: Operation Officer
scripts.text: You've dealt with a CP7 Mutant by yourself... did the battle went well?

scripts.speaker: Operation Officer
scripts.text: Here are the supplies and experience given to the troops that joined the operation. Take it.

scripts.speaker: Operation Officer
scripts.text: Even though it's a CP7 Rated, sorry I couldn't give you more experience.

scripts.speaker: Operation Officer
scripts.text: Let's go out now. We need to prepare for repairs quickly.
Look around more.
Go Out

scripts.speaker: Operation Officer
scripts.text: Is that so? Don't delay it for too long.
